title: The Twingo central dashboard: mere style effect or a true choice for use
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: The central display of the first Twingo is not an isolated whim. It belongs to a clearer, simpler and more open idea of the small car.
content:
The Twingo’s central dashboard played a large part in its image. It is sometimes reduced to a designer’s fancy. In fact, the choice belongs to a much more practical overall method.

Why the central cluster is not a whim

By grouping the display in the middle, Renault frees part of the dashboard and simplifies the general reading of the cabin. The Twingo gains an instantly distinct interior face, but also a useful sort of simplicity.

The gesture may look surprising at first. Once aboard, it becomes coherent with the rest of the project: less visual clutter and more room for simple shapes and storage.

What it changes inside

The small Renault tries to avoid a stacked feeling. The central dashboard, large glass area and high driving position all work in the same direction: giving air to a very short car.

That sense of openness matters almost as much as the measurements themselves. It strongly contributes to the feeling of space that marked early users.

A detail that identifies the first Twingo at once

Even today, this element is often enough to place the car in the model’s history. It recalls a time when Renault accepted doing things differently without making them harder to use.

That is why the Twingo dashboard is still discussed as a real design landmark and not only as a fashionable memory.
